question: A manufacturing company needs to transport 1800 units of products from the warehouse to three different sales points. The company has four transportation options to choose from: trucks, vans, motorcycles, and electric vehicles. Due to the high energy consumption of vans and electric vehicles, the company wants to choose only one of these two transportation options. Trucks generate 100 units of pollution per trip, vans generate 50 units of pollution, motorcycles generate 10 units of pollution, and electric vehicles generate 0 units of pollution. The total pollution generated by all trips must not exceed 2000 units. Trucks must be used at least 10 times. Trucks, vans, motorcycles, and electric vehicles can carry 100 units, 80 units, 40 units, and 60 units of products per trip, respectively. The company needs to ensure that the total quantity of products transported is at least 1800 units.

import pyomo.environ as pyo

DATA = {
    "options": ["truck", "van", "motorcycle", "ev"],
    "capacity": {"truck": 100, "van": 80, "motorcycle": 40, "ev": 60},
    "pollution": {"truck": 100, "van": 50, "motorcycle": 10, "ev": 0},
    "demand": 1800,
    "pollution_cap": 2000,
    "truck_min_trips": 10,
    "big_m": 1000,
}


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA
    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    # Sets
    model.V = pyo.Set(initialize=d["options"])

    # Variables
    model.trips = pyo.Var(model.V, domain=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers)
    model.use_van = pyo.Var(domain=pyo.Binary)
    model.use_ev = pyo.Var(domain=pyo.Binary)

    # Objective: minimise total pollution
    def obj_rule(m):
        return sum(d["pollution"][v] * m.trips[v] for v in m.V)
    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.minimize)

    # Demand: total units transported >= 1800
    def demand_rule(m):
        return sum(d["capacity"][v] * m.trips[v] for v in m.V) >= d["demand"]
    model.demand_con = pyo.Constraint(rule=demand_rule)

    # Pollution cap
    def pollution_rule(m):
        return sum(d["pollution"][v] * m.trips[v] for v in m.V) <= d["pollution_cap"]
    model.pollution_con = pyo.Constraint(rule=pollution_rule)

    # Trucks at least 10 trips
    def truck_min_rule(m):
        return m.trips["truck"] >= d["truck_min_trips"]
    model.truck_min_con = pyo.Constraint(rule=truck_min_rule)

    # Exactly one of vans / EVs
    def either_or_rule(m):
        return m.use_van + m.use_ev == 1
    model.either_or_con = pyo.Constraint(rule=either_or_rule)

    # Big-M linking: van trips only if van is chosen
    def van_link_rule(m):
        return m.trips["van"] <= d["big_m"] * m.use_van
    model.van_link_con = pyo.Constraint(rule=van_link_rule)

    # Big-M linking: EV trips only if EV is chosen
    def ev_link_rule(m):
        return m.trips["ev"] <= d["big_m"] * m.use_ev
    model.ev_link_con = pyo.Constraint(rule=ev_link_rule)

    return model

DATA = {
    "modes": ["truck", "van", "motorcycle", "ev"],
    "capacity": {"truck": 100, "van": 80, "motorcycle": 40, "ev": 60},
    "pollution": {"truck": 100, "van": 50, "motorcycle": 10, "ev": 0},
    "demand": 1800,
    "pollution_limit": 2000,
    "truck_min_trips": 10,
    "big_m": 10000,
}


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA
    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    model.T = pyo.Set(initialize=d["modes"])

    model.x = pyo.Var(model.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers)

    # Binary: 1 if van is used, 0 otherwise
    model.y_van = pyo.Var(within=pyo.Binary)
    # Binary: 1 if ev is used, 0 otherwise
    model.y_ev = pyo.Var(within=pyo.Binary)

    # (1) Total products transported >= demand
    def demand_rule(m):
        return sum(d["capacity"][t] * m.x[t] for t in m.T) >= d["demand"]
    model.demand_con = pyo.Constraint(rule=demand_rule)

    # (2) Total pollution <= limit
    def pollution_rule(m):
        return sum(d["pollution"][t] * m.x[t] for t in m.T) <= d["pollution_limit"]
    model.pollution_con = pyo.Constraint(rule=pollution_rule)

    # (3) Trucks used at least truck_min_trips times
    def truck_rule(m):
        return m.x["truck"] >= d["truck_min_trips"]
    model.truck_con = pyo.Constraint(rule=truck_rule)

    # (4) Choose only one of van / ev
    def choose_rule(m):
        return m.y_van + m.y_ev <= 1
    model.choose_con = pyo.Constraint(rule=choose_rule)

    # Link binaries to usage (big-M)
    def van_link_rule(m):
        return m.x["van"] <= d["big_m"] * m.y_van
    model.van_link_con = pyo.Constraint(rule=van_link_rule)

    def ev_link_rule(m):
        return m.x["ev"] <= d["big_m"] * m.y_ev
    model.ev_link_con = pyo.Constraint(rule=ev_link_rule)

    # Objective: minimise total pollution
    def obj_rule(m):
        return sum(d["pollution"][t] * m.x[t] for t in m.T)
    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.minimize)

    return model
